common_rules.numerical_authority: Canonical source geometry alone generates discrete assignments. Accepted source-bound signed maps alone drive observed and all null r, count, p and verdict. Geometry and null receipts never redefine the estimator.
common_rules.keys: Exact integral non-Boolean real numeric IDs, including exactly integral float NPZ axes, are accepted. CSV numeric keys accept scientific notation. No digit extraction or aliases. Literal labels and source paths remain exact strings.
common_rules.reorder: CSV rows/columns, NPZ parcel and rotation axes, keyed JSON null records, source_files records and map_support records may be coherently permuted.
common_rules.finite: Required measured arrays finite real non-Boolean. No pickle/object/structured/complex arrays. JSON numeric fields numeric, not Boolean or text. Null is only permitted where explicitly declared.
common_rules.extras: Bounded harmless additional files/columns/JSON fields/NPZ arrays allowed; required evidence and keys unchanged. NPZ extras must have supported finite numeric/Boolean/text dtypes. Extras do not change the estimator.
common_rules.undefined: Canonical exactconstant or zero stable-centered L2 is inactive. Preserve all parcels/rotations. Inactive observed or any inactive required null leaves exceedance/numerator/p/significance null; denominator remains R+1 and defined individual diagnostics remain.
common_rules.failure: Any lexists failure_report.json invalidates success, including empty/dangling marker.
common_rules.safety: Required artifacts regular non-symlink files, directory inventory excludes symlink/special entries; duplicate JSON keys, CSV keys/columns and NPZ members invalid.
common_rules.scoring: Production validates submitted evidence once. Equivalent-transformation and mutation QA are authoring only; valid outputs are not required to remain valid after perturbations or extra content.

centered_fidelity.scope: both observed maps and every canonically active remapped gradient; one common prescale for own/reference centering

geometry_receipts.scope: receipt only; never generate assignments from accepted rounded geometry

scalar_receipts.scope: signed observed/null r and p; no rounding or tolerance in inclusive rank comparator

tolerances.exact: IDs, seed, N, assignment IDs, labels, source identities, support counts/digests, activity/statuses, exceedance counts and Boolean decisions.

columns.label: literal source label
columns.support_sha256: lowercase SHA256 of MAPREL_support_v2\n + hemisphere ASCII + \n + ascending original local vertex IDs little-endian int64

centroids.meaning: canonical arithmetic mean sphere coordinates, radial normalized to radius 100, as receipt

spin_parcel_ids.meaning: mapped literal SOURCE parcel IDs, NOT output row positions

spin_evidence_npz.mapping_rules: Original allows many-to-one within hemisphere; vasa/hungarian each preserve one-to-one membership. All assignments equal pinned canonical-geometry method/seed/N trace. Evidence axis permutations do not alter it.

required.pearson_r: finite real in [-1,1] if observed_status ok, otherwise null
required.null_distribution: R keyed records {rotation_id:int,status:ok|inactive_gradient|inactive_thickness|inactive_both,r:finite [-1,1] or null}; exact key coverage 0..R-1
required.n_null_expected: exact integer R, including every undefined or repeated slot
required.n_null_defined: exact integer number of status-ok null slots, 0..R
required.n_exceedances: exact integer 0..R iff observed and all R nulls defined, otherwise null
required.p_spin_numerator: exact integer 1+n_exceedances iff observed and all R nulls defined, otherwise null
required.p_spin_denominator: exact integer R+1 always, including incomplete support
required.inference_status: ok iff observed and all R nulls defined; incomplete_support otherwise

results_json.rank_rule: abs(unrounded own null r)>=abs(unrounded own observed r), inclusive, no tie epsilon. Repeated retained mappings are separate slots. No source-canonical count/p target.

required.source_files: closed keyed list {path,role,size_bytes,sha256} for all authenticated scientific and provenance files; row order free
required.source_observed: canonical source metadata record described below; extra descriptive fields allowed

analysis_observed.map_support: exact two keyed records {map_id:gradient2|thickness,active:Boolean}; source canonical
analysis_observed.remapped_gradient: {n_expected:R,n_active:exact integer 0..R} from canonical source maps and assignments

required.software_versions: nonempty object with nonempty name/string version values describing actual software; versions not secret exact fingerprint
required.warnings: list of strings; may be empty/nonempty, not an outcome gate

source_observed.gifti_record: {role,hemisphere,metadata,arrays,vertex_count,declared_hemispheres}; original metadata literal; arrays source ordered
source_observed.gifti_array_record: {intent,shape,dtype,metadata,coordinate_system:null|{dataspace,xformspace,matrix}}; dtype must be a string with semantic NumPy dtype equality, including kind, width and effective byteorder. Native and explicit-native-endian aliases accepted; object, structured/subarray, different width or nonmatching endian rejected. This equivalence applies only to arrays[].dtype in the six GIFTI roles, not arbitrary metadata strings named dtype.
source_observed.atlas_structure_record: {brain_structure,entries,nonzero_entries} plus {hemisphere,full_surface_vertices,vertex_ids_sha256} for cortical structures; original structure order preserved
source_observed.note: The authenticated release has full 32492-vertex hemispheres and a [1,64984] cortical atlas. Keyed joins retain all 400 nonzero parcels and 58606 supported vertices. No values-derived support selection is authorized.

findings_md: Nonempty UTF-8 text. No required outcome, keywords, p direction, difficulty claim or paper-result match.
